ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.6:0.4 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized high-intensity white regions on both lobes; right lobe exhibits a larger contiguous white zone compared to the left. Peripheral black margins transition into heavy internal mottling/speckling within the white zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 50 degrees; deep vertical penetration relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary of both lobes, characterized by multiple sharp peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edges sweeping distally and upward; leading edges exhibit a smooth convex curve terminating at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, irregular white and dark pixels at both distal tips (corners), indicating barnacle colonization or localized scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark, near-parallel linear streaks (rake marks) observed on the mid-to-inner white region of the right lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle encrustations or associated scarring at the furthest lateral extensions (tips) of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive 'salt and pepper' pixel distribution (mottling) throughout the white portions of the fluke, particularly concentrated towards the inner lobes near the notch.
